## Purpose / 目的

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `app/gradlew test` or `app\gradlew.bat test` passes.
- [ ] Native/integration checks executed, or explicitly listed as not executed.
- [ ] New rules include positive, negative, boundary, and validation-code cases where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and Chinese/English UI text were updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No real documents, personal data, secrets, tokens, passwords, ciphertext, or local paths were committed.
- [ ] New dependencies and test data have documented provenance and compatible licenses.

## Security and compatibility / 安全与兼容性

State fail-closed behavior, affected formats/platforms, residual-scan impact, and remaining limitations.
